analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and file metadata against the indexed threat model and selected detailed definitions. Changes replace Date ordering with signed time-interval comparisons, preserving equality and ordering for finite timestamps; no supported security regression was identified.

In provider-swift/Sources/ProviderAppAttest/, AppAttestKeyHistoryBuilder.swift:50 preserves the diagnostic 24-hour generation count; EnrollmentKeyLifecycle.swift:6 preserves generation eligibility and the surrounding retirement/retry rules. ShadowEnrollmentAttempt.swift:20 preserves rejection of future transcripts and the 24-hour resumption limit, with key, hash, session-format and protocol-3 checks unchanged. AppAttestStallRestart.swift:130 still requires verification after the previous restart; freshness, profile checks, six-hour rate limiting, drain ownership and marker behavior remain unchanged. These interactions concern A-015/A-016, TB-011 and T-052/T-053/T-057; local history and restart markers do not become serving authorization.

ClusterModelProvisioningStore.swift patch lines 164, 193 and 230 preserve retry eligibility and deadline termination. Surrounding catalog parsing, same-artifact checks, worker acceptance, atomic manifest replacement and bundled artifact selection remain unchanged, relevant to A-004, T-012/T-027 and availability. No supplied change alters prompt encryption, cache isolation/TTL (T-041), token custody, billing, privileged helpers or add-on execution.

Coverage is limited to these five files; the cluster HEAD is supplied only as patches, and unchanged callers and backend implementations were not examined. Integration should reconcile other PR units with these preserved time gates, particularly enrollment resumption and restart lifecycle callers. No material unresolved security contract arises from these local comparison substitutions.
